import pandas as pd
t = tables['trips']
# Season 6 recent window
t6 = t[(t.fished_date_season==6) & (t.fished_date_doy>=121) & (t.fished_date_doy<=152)]
g6 = t6.groupby('cls').agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'), n=('yt','size'))
g6['ypa'] = g6.yt/g6.anglers
result1 = g6.sort_values('ypa', ascending=False)

# All seasons, by class and 30-day doy bucket, pooled ypa (excluding current season 6 partial future)
t_all = t.copy()
t_all['bucket'] = (t_all.fished_date_doy // 30) * 30
g_all = t_all.groupby(['cls','bucket']).agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'), n=('yt','size')).reset_index()
g_all['ypa'] = g_all.yt/g_all.anglers
g_all = g_all[g_all.n>=10]
result2 = g_all.sort_values(['cls','bucket'])

result = {'recent_s6': result1, 'all_seasons_by_bucket': result2}

SELECT cls, CAST(fished_date_doy/30 AS INT)*30 AS bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/SUM(anglers),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY cls, bucket
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY cls, bucket

SELECT cls, CAST(fished_date_doy/30 AS INT)*30 AS bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/SUM(anglers),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','hd_twilight')
GROUP BY cls, bucket
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY ypa DESC
LIMIT 15
